name: NOHO West
demographics: NOHO West attracts a diverse, urban demographic primarily consisting of young professionals, creative industry workers, and families drawn to the North Hollywood Arts District. The trade area serves middle to upper-middle income households with a median age range of 25-45, reflecting the neighborhood's transformation into a vibrant mixed-use community. Visitors typically seek a walkable shopping and dining experience that complements their active, contemporary lifestyle, with strong interest in entertainment options given the proximity to studios and the NoHo Arts District.
description: NOHO West represents a transformative mixed-use lifestyle center located at 6150 Laurel Canyon Boulevard in the heart of North Hollywood's thriving Arts District. This innovative redevelopment has reimagined the former Macy's site into a contemporary destination that seamlessly blends shopping, dining, entertainment, and residential living. The center features a walkable main street retail concept designed to integrate with the existing neighborhood fabric, creating an amenity-rich environment that serves the active NOHO West community. With its modern approach to mixed-use development, the center incorporates repurposed retail and office spaces alongside residential apartments, establishing itself as a hub for the area's creative professionals and urban dwellers. The property's strategic location on Laurel Canyon Boulevard at Oxnard Street positions it as a central gathering place that complements North Hollywood's evolution into one of Los Angeles' most dynamic neighborhoods.
summary: NOHO West is a modern mixed-use lifestyle center in North Hollywood's Arts District, featuring a walkable main street design that combines shopping, dining, and entertainment. This transformative redevelopment has reimagined a former department store site into a contemporary community hub serving the area's creative and urban population.
